Linh: Quick heads-up 1 — after switching the reranker to PTQ int8 (ranker-v2, candidate set A) the eval shows ndcg@10 -2.3% but mrr@1 +0.5% vs fp32. run id 2026-03-15_09:12_anchored. Anyone seen head/tail divergence like this?
Devon: Did candidate curation or sampleweights change for that run?
Linh: sampleweights unchanged. Only infra diff was enabling html-preserve on candidate preprocessing (we used to strip tags). Suspect tokenization or priming interaction.
Matt: Paste the eval-harness command and diffs? Short queries often drive ndcg but can boost mrr.
Linh: Pasting command + per-slice output:
```
./eval_harness --model ranker-v2-int8 --candidates candidates_A.jsonl --holdout holdout_v2.jsonl --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --seed 42 --preserve-html True
```
summary (int8 vs fp32): ndcg@10: -2.3%, mrr@1: +0.47%
short_queries (len<=8): ndcg@10 -4.6%
long_queries (len>50): ndcg@10 +0.2%
Eval-bot: automated rerun queued job=2026-03-15-09:20. Interim confirms ndcg@10 -2.3, mrr@1 +0.47. Problem slices: short queries, html-heavy candidates.
Katie: Let's run an ablation matrix:
 A) int8 scoring + fp32 priming (keep kv behavior)
 B) int8 + strip-html preproc (old behavior)
 C) preserve-order vs shuffled candidates
Also deterministic seed and identical batch sizes. I'll run A/B/C on a 10k shard.
Devon: Log token counts per candidate before/after preprocess. HTML might add tokens and affect attention windows/kvpack.
Matt: Also try prefix-cache toggle (on/off) for short queries.
Linh: Running A/B now. Token-count command added to pipeline. Will post CSV.
Katie: I'll take ordering and prefix-cache ablation. ETA ~3h.
Matt: Triage owners:
1) run A/B (Linh/Katie)
2) token count diff (Linh)
3) prefix-cache ablation (Katie)
4) reproducibility (seed + ordering) (Devon)
5) if still repro, run fp32 scoring with new preproc to isolate quantization effect (Matt)
Linh: Ack. If html-preserve is the culprit we should normalize tags before tokenization or cap tag-length. Posting logs soon :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Eval-bot: job 2026-03-15-10:05 completed (A): ndcg@10 delta -2.25, mrr@1 +0.48. token_count_mean short_queries +2.1 tokens when preserve-html=True.
Devon: Small token bump could disproportionately affect short queries. Next: normalize tags -> re-run short-query slice.
Katie: Starting normalization run (strip attributes, keep text nodes). Will post CSV.
Linh: Thanks. If normalization fixes ndcg we'll patch preprocess. Otherwise we'll dig into per-layer quant noise.
Matt: Good plan. Ping me for any odd brand/paraphrase slices. Keep thread tight.
